Vendored unmodified `xxhash.h` from xxHash v0.8.3:
https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash/tree/v0.8.3

Used in header-only mode (`XXH_INLINE_ALL`) for `XXH3_128bits`, matching the
Rust implementation's `xxhash_rust::xxh3::xxh3_128`. No download or system
xxHash package is needed during the build. See LICENSE for BSD-2-Clause terms.
